toolsPreview.name: list_photos
toolsPreview.description: List every available holiday photo with its ID and description.

toolsPreview.name: get_photo
toolsPreview.description: Display a holiday photo to the user by creating an HTML artifact that embeds the photo from its hosted URL. After calling this tool you MUST create an HTML artifact (type text/html) whose body is a single tag pointing at the hosted URL returned in the result. Do not write a prose description, caption, or commentary — the user wants to view the photo, not read about it. Use list_photos first to discover valid IDs.
